name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck orders and kitchen
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, save the kitchen from more orders than it needs and keep service going even when the signal goes. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the order and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order ahead and choose a pickup time. Your staff see every order on a single screen, confirm what the kitchen can make, then mark the order “Ready” and “Picked up”.

■ Don’t give a time you can’t keep
Set how much your kitchen can make at once and how much time it takes. When a pickup time fills up, customers can’t choose it, so the queue runs at the kitchen’s pace.

■ Take orders right at the truck
Add walk-in orders on the same screen where pre-orders come in, so the kitchen works from a single queue.

■ One screen for the kitchen
The kitchen display shows what to make now, what’s next and what’s ready, and gives an alert when an order needs starting.

■ Print order tickets
Connect the kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or over your local network, and order tickets will print automatically.

■ Keep service going even when the signal goes
Switch on offline protection: when the connection breaks, pre-orders stop, so nobody places an order you can’t even see. Orders taken on the device stay saved and sync as soon as you are back online.

■ Made for the food truck
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

■ Plan your week
Set up your events and places once and take orders for each one.

HatchGrab is for people who run food trucks and their staff. A HatchGrab account is needed to sign in.
whatsNew:
HatchGrab is now available in 50+ languages.

Now print order tickets on a kitchen printer on your local network as well as over Bluetooth.

Bug fixes and improvements.
shortDescription: Pre-orders, pickup time and a kitchen display for food trucks — all in one place.
